title: Exponential Mixing for 2D Stochastic Damped Euler Equation Driven by Bounded Noise
summary: In this paper, we study the long-time behaviour of the two-dimensional stochastic damped Euler equation on the torus driven by bounded random forcing. Unlike stochastic Navier-Stokes or fractionally dissipative Euler equations, the model possesses no viscous regularisation, so the classical parabolic smoothing is unavailable. We prove that when the damping coefficient is sufficiently large, the associated Markov semigroup admits a unique invariant measure and converges exponentially fast to equilibrium.
